name: pricing_p1
hypothesis: Per qualified booked survey is an acceptable billing unit for installers, and £150 still gets at least half of qualified prospects to send a sample of old quotes.
variable: price per qualified booked survey quoted on the call (model held constant)
primary_metric: sample_sent_rate after the price was quoted
guardrails: price named as the main objection
prospect asks for a different billing model
decision_rule: Directional only: expect 5-20 calls in the first 6 weeks. Choose the higher price if at least half of qualified prospects send a sample and price is not the most common objection. Never put a price in writing; quote it on the call. Re-test once 3 pilots give real cost and conversion data.
assignment: fixed per company (hash of company id), so a prospect always hears the same price
terms_for_every_arm: Billable only when a homeowner confirms interest and agrees a survey date
First batch capped (e.g. max 20 billable surveys) so the bill can't run away
